fusions.name: Stampede of One
fusions.desc: A charge that deals 14 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles ahead and knocks it 3 tiles back. Its damage rises by 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Long Drink
fusions.desc: Sends a flea at the first enemy in a line up to 6 tiles away that deals 4 damage. 30% of the damage comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds, and each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Leaden] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Herd Grazing
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds, rising by 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Cud Strength
fusions.desc: When you regain health, you also regain 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
